user: How long does a SWIFT transfer take?
answer:
The knowledge base doesn't include a processing time for SWIFT transfers, so I can't give you a figure. The only timing it mentions is that a transfer rejected by the beneficiary bank is returned within five business days.

For the expected delivery time, you can:
- Ask a human agent, who can check the current timing for your transfer. I can escalate this now if you'd like.
- Check the transfer's status in your transaction history after you send it.

fragments.text:
Transfers
## Failed transfers
A transfer rejected by the beneficiary bank is returned within five business
days. Fees already charged on a returned SWIFT transfer are not refunded.

Verta tariff schedule
## Transfer fees by type
| Transfer type | Flat fee | Percentage fee |
|---|---|---|
| Internal | EUR 0.00 | 0% |
| SEPA | EUR 0.35 | 0% |
| SWIFT | EUR 15.00 | 0.3% |
| Card payment | EUR 0.00 | 1.2% |

The percentage fee is calculated on the EUR equivalent of the transfer amount.

Fee details
## How the SWIFT fee is composed
A SWIFT transfer carries a flat fee plus a percentage of the EUR equivalent of
the amount sent. Correspondent bank charges deducted en route are outside the
control of Verta and are not refunded.

Notifications
## Delivery failures
If the registered email bounces three times the address is marked unverified
and statement delivery is suspended until it is corrected.
